1029.description: A seated machine press with parallel handles, working the chest with a stable path.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height and sit back.
Grip the handles with your elbows slightly below shoulder level.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Keep your back against the pad.

1093.description: A chest dip with your feet on the floor for help. It builds the chest and triceps.
instructions: Hold the handles with arms straight and feet on the floor.
Lean your chest forward.
Lower your body by bending your elbows.
Use your legs for light help.
Press back up.
Keep your shoulders down.

1157.description: Holding the straps, you hinge the hips back and forth to train the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Hold the handles with arms straight and feet hip width apart.
Soften your knees.
Push your hips back with a flat back.
Lean on the straps for balance.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze the glutes at the top.

1221.description: Shrugging with a lever press machine as the load. It builds the upper traps with a stable, guided path.
instructions: Set the machine so the handles are at your sides and grip them firmly.
Stand or sit tall with your arms straight.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top for a moment.
Lower your shoulders slowly without rolling them.

1285.description: Flat bench fly with a single dumbbell. Lowering in a wide arc stretches one side of the chest, and bringing it back squeezes it.
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand, resting it on top of your thigh.
Lie back on the bench, keeping the dumbbell pressed against your thigh.
Using your free hand, help lift the dumbbell up to the starting position.
Hold the dumbbell directly above your shoulder with your arm extended and palm facing inward.
Lower the dumbbell out to the side in a wide arc, keeping a slight bend in your elbow.
Pause when your arm is parallel to the ground, then reverse the movement and bring the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms and repeat.
instructionsZh: 坐在平坦的长凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，将其放在大腿上方。
向后躺在长凳上，将哑铃压在大腿上。
用空着的那只手帮助将哑铃举至起始位置。
将哑铃握在肩膀正上方，手臂伸展，手掌朝内。
将哑铃以宽弧线向一侧放低，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
当手臂与地面平行时暂停，然后反向运动并将哑铃带回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂重复。

1349.description: A reverse grip row on a t-bar style machine, chest supported. It builds the upper back and lats with a strict path.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and footplate position on the leverage machine.
Sit on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the footplate.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Pull the handles towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release and extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整杠杆机上的座椅高度和踏板位置。
坐在机器上，胸部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在踏板上。
正手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
将手柄拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开并伸展手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1413.description: A one-arm curl with a cable using an overhand grip. It works the forearms and the outer part of the biceps.
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the cable handle with an underhand grip, palm facing down.
Keep your elbow close to your side and slowly curl your forearm up towards your shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your forearm back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面向缆绳机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
反手握住电缆手柄，手掌朝下。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，慢慢地将前臂向上卷向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将前臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1541.description: Squat down with the bar hanging in front of you, then stand and pull it up to chest height. Works thighs, glutes and upper back in one move.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Push your hips back and squat down, letting the bar slide down to your knees.
Drive up through your heels to stand tall.
As you rise, pull the bar up close to your body until your elbows reach shoulder height.
Lower the bar under control and go straight into the next squat.

1605.description: A cable pushdown using an SZ bar, a staple for building the back of the arm.
instructions: Attach an SZ bar to a high pulley and grip it with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Pin your elbows to your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are fully straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Let the bar rise slowly until your forearms are just above parallel.

1669.description: A one-arm seated hammer curl. It trains the brachialis and biceps on one side at a time.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with a neutral grip (palms facing each other).
Rest your elbow on the inside of your thigh, just above the knee.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
一只手握住哑铃，保持中立握姿（手掌相对）。
将肘部放在大腿内侧、膝盖上方。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将哑铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1733.description: A two-arm dumbbell triceps extension on an incline bench. It stretches and builds the triceps.
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Slowly lie back on the bench, keeping the dumbbells close to your chest.
Once you are fully lying down, extend your arms straight up towards the ceiling, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在上斜凳上，每只手各拿一个哑铃，放在大腿上。
慢慢地躺在长凳上，保持哑铃靠近胸部。
完全躺下后，将手臂伸向天花板，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1797.description: Reaching both arms up and slightly back lengthens the lats and upper back. A simple stretch to open your sides.
instructions: Stand tall and reach both arms overhead with your palms facing each other.
Reach up and lean slightly back, keeping your lower back relaxed and your ribs down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1861.description: Standing cable curl using a V bar, giving constant tension on the biceps.
instructions: Attach a multipurpose V bar to a low pulley and grip it with palms up.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly without letting your elbows drift.

1925.description: Dropping one heel off a step to stretch the calf through a full range.
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step with the ball of one foot on it and hold a rail for balance.
Slowly lower that heel below the step until you feel the calf stretch.
Keep the knee straight to hit the calf, then bend it slightly to reach deeper into the soleus.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1989.description: A hanging stretch between parallel bars that opens the shoulders and lengthens the lats.
instructions: Stand between parallel bars and grip them at hip height.
Walk back slightly, letting your arms straighten.
Lower your chest toward the floor and press your head between your arms.
Feel the stretch in the lats and shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then walk forward to release.

2117.description: A standing side bend for the sides of the waist and ribs.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Reach one arm overhead and bend sideways away from it until you feel the side stretch.
Keep your chest open and your hips level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2309.description: A pushing front kick that drives the heel forward to create distance, working hips and quads.
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift the knee and point the toes up.
Push your heel straight forward, leaning back slightly.
Keep your supporting foot grounded.
Bring the leg back and set it down.
Repeat, then switch legs.

2757.description: A hip thrust with the soles of the feet together and knees out, which shifts work to the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out.
Keep your heels near your hips.
Drive through the feet to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

2949.description: Rolling the side of your back on a foam roller. It can loosen tight lats before overhead work.
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under your armpit area and your arm extended.
Support yourself with your lower arm and legs.
Roll slowly along your side toward the ribs.
Pause on tight spots for a few seconds.
Switch sides and keep the pressure comfortable.

3013.description: A low glute bridge on the floor, lifting your hips. Works the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your arms by your sides, palms facing down.
Engage your glutes and core, then lift your hips off the ground until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your glutes.
Slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将手臂放在身体两侧，手掌朝下。
启动臀肌和核心肌群，然后将臀部抬离地面，直到身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压臀部。
慢慢地将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3141.description: A floor stability move reaching opposite arm and leg to train the back and core.
instructions: Start on all fours with a neutral spine.
Extend one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Keep your hips level and avoid arching your back.
Pause for a moment.
Return and switch sides.

3269.description: Run in place and add a hop to lift the heart rate and wake up the legs.
instructions: Stand tall with feet under your hips.
Run on the spot at a steady pace, pumping your arms.
Every few steps, hop off one foot and land softly.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep going for 30-60 seconds at a pace you can hold.

3333.description: A one arm dumbbell bench press with a wide elbow path, stressing the chest while your core resists rotation.
instructions: Lie on a bench with one dumbbell held over your chest.
Place your free arm on your stomach or out to the side.
Lower the dumbbell with elbow flared out until you feel a chest stretch.
Press it back up over your chest.
Keep your torso square, then switch arms after the set.

3397.description: A hip-driven swing with a dumbbell, taking the weight from between the legs to overhead.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell with both hands and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge back and swing the weight between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing the dumbbell overhead.
Let it fall back and hinge again.
Keep your back flat and your arms loose.
Control the dumbbell at all times.

3461.description: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 1 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

3525.description: A kneeling single-arm press with a landmine. It trains the shoulders and builds core stability.
instructions: Kneel facing the end of a landmine barbell.
Hold the end at shoulder height with one hand.
Keep your core tight and torso upright.
Press the end up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower with control.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.

3589.description: Trot in place at a quick pace to warm up and get your heart rate up.
instructions: Stand tall with arms bent at your sides.
Lift your knees and run lightly on the spot.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms with each step.
Keep the pace for 30-60 seconds or longer.

3653.description: A sprinting drill with band assistance to practice fast leg turnover.
instructions: Anchor a band behind you and loop it around your waist.
Lean forward into a sprint position.
Drive your knees and pump your arms.
Stay light on your feet.
Repeat for short bursts.

3781.description: An explosive split jump with a one-arm band row. It builds power in your legs and trains your back.
instructions: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Start in a split stance with a slight bend in both knees.
Jump up and switch legs in mid-air.
Land softly in the opposite split stance and row the handle to your ribs.
Alternate legs, and switch rowing arm for the next set.

3845.description: A seated row with a band while keeping your back straight. It builds your upper back and lats.
instructions: Sit with legs extended and the band around your feet.
Hold the handles with your arms straight and your back tall.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly without rounding your back.

3973.description: A one-leg calf raise holding a dumbbell for extra load. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on the ball of the opposite foot, ideally on a step.
Rest your free hand on a wall or rail for balance.
Lift your heel as high as you can, squeezing the calf.
Pause for a moment at the top.
Lower your heel slowly below the step level, then repeat and switch legs.

4101.description: A crunch with straight legs raised, reaching toward your toes while holding a weight for extra resistance.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight up and a weight held in both hands.
Reach the weight toward your toes.
Lift your shoulder blades off the floor.
Lower slowly with control.
Keep your legs vertical and your neck relaxed.

4229.description: A run on a self-powered curved treadmill where your effort sets the speed. It is a hard cardio workout for the legs and lungs.
instructions: Step onto the curved treadmill and hold the handles.
Lean slightly forward and begin to run.
Drive your knees and push the belt back with each stride.
Keep a steady rhythm, or alternate sprints and rest.
Land on the balls of your feet.
Slow down gradually to finish.

4293.description: A hip hinge with nearly straight legs and dumbbells. It stretches and strengthens the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your legs almost straight with a soft knee and a flat back.
Push your hips back and lower the weights along your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.

4357.description: A simple biceps curl with a band underfoot. It trains the front of the arms with elastic resistance.
instructions: Stand on the band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ends, palms up.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Curl your hands toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly against the band.

4421.description: Kicking one leg back from a hands-and-knees position against cable resistance. It isolates the glutes.
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and get on all fours facing the machine.
Hook the strap around one ankle.
Keeping the knee bent, drive your heel up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Return slowly and repeat, then switch legs.

4485.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the back of the shoulder blade (infraspinatus). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your back of the shoulder blade (infraspinatus) while leaning back against a wall.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4613.description: An unloaded overhead press against a wall to groove a clean path and open the shoulders.
instructions: Stand with your back, head and hips against a wall, hands at shoulder height with elbows bent.
Brace your abs so your lower back stays on the wall.
Press your hands straight overhead until your arms are locked out.
Lower back to shoulder height with control.
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows.

4677.description: Kicking one leg back from a kneeling position against a band. It isolates the glutes.
instructions: Get on all fours with a band looped around your foot and hands.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Extend one leg back, squeezing your glute.
Pause briefly at full extension.
Return with control and repeat, then switch legs.

4741.description: A row with your forehead resting on a bench pad so your lower back stays relaxed. It focuses on the upper back.
instructions: Set a bench at a slight incline and lie chest down on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
Rest your forehead on the top and let your arms hang.
Row both dumbbells toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

4805.description: A bodyweight squat with a wide stance and toes turned out. It puts extra work on the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with feet well wider than your shoulders and toes angled out.
Raise your arms in front for balance.
Sit your hips down and back, pushing your knees out over your toes.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.

4933.description: Circles with a straight leg while standing. It loosens the hips and warms up the glutes.
instructions: Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Lift one leg slightly off the floor.
Draw a smooth circle with the leg.
Keep your torso still.
Reverse the direction after several reps.
Switch legs.

5061.description: Hold your head lifted while lying face down. It builds endurance in the neck extensors.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms by your sides.
Tuck your chin slightly.
Lift your head a few inches off the floor.
Hold steady while breathing normally.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower slowly.

5317.description: Pull a band apart with your arms angled upward at about 45 degrees. Strengthens the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Hold a resistance band in both hands in front of you.
Raise your arms to about 45 degrees above horizontal.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your ribs down and your shoulders away from your ears.

5381.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the rhomboids. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Sit with the roller behind your upper back and cross your arms.
Place the roller under the rhomboids and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll up and down between your shoulder blades.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5445.description: Drawing your belly in as far as you can while standing. Trains the deep abdominal muscles that keep your trunk tight.
instructions: Stand tall with your hands on your hips and feet hip-width apart.
Exhale fully until your lungs feel empty.
Pull your belly button toward your spine and hold it there.
Hold for 10-20 seconds without breathing in deeply.
Relax and breathe normally, then repeat.

5637.description: Push-up with hands elevated on a bench, an easier version of the push-up.
instructions: Place hands on a bench slightly wider than shoulders.
Walk your feet back into a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bench.
Press back up.
Keep your core tight.

5701.description: A squat that starts each rep from a dead stop on safety pins. It removes the bounce and builds strength out of the bottom.
instructions: Set the safety pins at the depth you want and place the bar on them.
Duck under the bar and lift it onto your upper back.
Squat down until the bar rests on the pins.
Pause briefly while staying tight.
Drive up through your whole foot to stand.

6149.description: A curl where the elbows move back and the dumbbells drag up along your torso. It hits the biceps with less shoulder help.
instructions: Sit holding dumbbells with your palms forward.
Keep the weights close to your body.
Pull your elbows back as you curl.
Drag the dumbbells up along your torso.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control.

6341.description: A lunge with a forward fold and clasped hands behind you. It stretches the hips, hamstrings and shoulders.
instructions: Step into a wide lunge with the front knee bent.
Clasp your hands behind your back.
Fold your torso inside your front thigh.
Let your arms float overhead.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

6789.description: A lying check comparing the length of both legs. It is done gently and with a relaxed body.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with legs straight and feet together.
Relax your hips and arms.
Compare the position of your heels or ankles.
Bend your knees and lift your hips, then lower and straighten again.
Check again for any difference.
Stay relaxed throughout.

7237.description: Deadlift using a hook grip, where the thumb is trapped under the fingers, for a secure hold on heavy pulls.
instructions: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and grip it with your thumbs under your fingers.
Hinge down, brace your core and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out with hips and knees extended.
Lower the bar under control by hinging at the hips first.

7557.description: Wall sit with feet close together to focus on the quads.
instructions: Lean your back on a wall with feet close together.
Slide down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep knees over ankles.
Hold for 20-60 seconds.
Slide back up slowly.

7621.description: A bench press started from a dead stop on safety pins, using a standard grip. It builds strength off the chest without any bounce.
instructions: Set the pins at a height just above your chest and lie on the bench.
Grab the bar at about shoulder-width plus a little.
Pause the bar on the pins to remove momentum.
Press the bar straight up until your arms lock out.
Lower back to the pins with control and reset for each rep.

8197.description: A seated move where your arms alternate in a swimming motion. A gentle shoulder warm-up for any time.
instructions: Sit upright near the edge of a chair.
Lean forward slightly with a flat back.
Reach one arm forward and the other back, then alternate.
Move in a steady rhythm.
Keep your core braced.

8901.description: Lifting one arm out to the side against a cable keeps constant tension on the side delt. It builds shoulder width.
instructions: Stand side-on to the low cable and hold the handle with the far hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm out to the side up to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly against the cable.
Avoid leaning or swinging, then switch arms.

9605.description: A step-down drill with a slow, controlled lowering. It builds quad strength and knee stability.
instructions: Stand on a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot slowly toward the floor.
Keep your knee stable and your torso tall.
Touch the floor lightly.
Rise back up through the working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

9989.description: A mobility drill where you use a stick behind your back to help rotate the shoulder inward. It improves reach and range.
instructions: Stand tall holding a stick behind your back, one hand low and the other high.
Let the lower hand grip the stick as the working arm.
With the top hand, gently pull the stick up so the lower hand rises along your back.
Go until you feel a mild stretch.
Hold for 2 seconds, then release.
Keep your shoulders level, then switch sides.

10053.description: An explosive jump that starts from a seated position on a box or chair, building power in the legs.
instructions: Sit on a sturdy box or bench with feet flat.
Lean slightly forward with arms ready.
Explode upward, swinging your arms.
Land softly on both feet with bent knees.
Sit back down and reset.
Repeat with a short pause each time.

10117.description: A half kneeling clean and press that trains the shoulder while the stance forces your core and hips to stay stable.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the dumbbell on the floor by your front foot and grab it.
Pull the dumbbell up to your shoulder in one smooth motion, rotating your wrist.
Press it overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder, then to the floor with control.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch sides.

10437.description: A one-armed seated row with a rope handle on a low pulley. It works the lats and upper back one side at a time.
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and sit facing the stack with your feet braced.
Hold the rope in one hand with your arm extended.
Pull your elbow back along your side, squeezing your shoulder blade.
Pause, then let the arm extend slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

10565.description: Sit in a 90-degree hip position and press forward to stretch the glutes and hips. It improves hip rotation.
instructions: Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one leg in front, one to the side.
Sit tall.
Hinge forward over the front shin with a flat back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides and repeat.

10757.description: Quick lateral hops powered by the calves. They improve ankle strength and foot speed.
instructions: Stand tall with feet together and knees slightly soft.
Spring off your toes and hop to one side.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Immediately hop to the other side.
Keep your chest up and hips level.
Continue alternating for the set.

10949.description: Swinging the dumbbells with straight arms to load the biceps. A shoulder and arm builder.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Swing the dumbbells forward and up in a controlled arc.
Lower them back down.
Keep your torso still and avoid momentum.

11077.description: A side-lying hip abduction while you hold a dumbbell over your chest. It trains the outer hips and adds a core challenge.
instructions: Lie on your side with legs stacked and hold a dumbbell over your chest with both hands.
Keep your hips stacked and core braced.
Raise your top leg without rotating your torso.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control, finish your reps, then switch sides.

11269.description: A bent-over one-arm row with a low cable. It builds the lats and mid back with steady tension.
instructions: Face a low pulley, hinge forward with a flat back and hold the handle.
Brace your core and keep your hips back.
Row the handle toward your hip.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

11653.description: A simple standing contraction that wakes up the glutes and helps you feel them working before heavier lifts.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart and your arms relaxed.
Tighten your abs lightly so your ribs stay stacked over your hips.
Squeeze your glutes together as hard as you comfortably can.
Hold for 3-5 seconds without leaning back or tucking your hips excessively.
Relax fully, then repeat for 10-15 reps.

11717.description: An explosive push-up variation where your hands leave the floor, building upper-body power.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Explode upward so your hands leave the ground.
Land softly with slightly bent elbows.
Reset your body line and repeat.

11781.description: An explosive jump onto a low step box that builds power in the legs and trains soft, controlled landings.
instructions: Stand facing a step box with your feet hip width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump explosively up onto the box, landing softly with bent knees.
Stand tall on top, then step back down one foot at a time.
Reset and repeat, staying quick but controlled.

0005.description: A biceps curl done one arm at a time against a band stood on with your feet. It gives rising tension toward the top of the curl.
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band and hold an end in each hand.
Keep your elbows at your sides with palms forward.
Curl one hand up toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly while curling the other hand.
Keep your upper arms still and avoid leaning back.
Alternate sides for your reps.

0069.description: A squat with the bar held locked out overhead. Builds mobility, stability and leg strength.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Hold the barbell with a wide grip, positioning it overhead with your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and lower your body down into a squat position, keeping your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微外翻。
宽握距握住杠铃，将其置于头顶，双臂完全伸展。
收紧核心肌群，将身体放低至蹲姿，保持胸部向上，膝盖位于脚趾上方。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0133.description: A side plank with the knees bent, a more approachable version of the full move. It strengthens the obliques and the side of the hip.
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent and your elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your hips and knees.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from knee to head.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower your hips with control.
Repeat on the other side.

0197.description: A seated pulldown using a pro lat bar. You pull the bar to the upper chest to build the lats and upper back.
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that your thighs are parallel to the ground and your feet are flat on the floor.
Grasp the lat bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Sit down and lean back slightly, keeping your chest up and your back straight.
Pull the bar down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the bar back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，使大腿与地面平行，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住背阔肌杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
坐下来，稍微向后倾斜，保持挺胸、背部挺直。
将杠铃向下拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃释放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0261.description: A push-up where you twist the hips and body as you descend. It adds trunk rotation to a standard chest exercise.
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor while rotating your hips slightly to one side.
Push up and return to the centre.
Repeat to the other side.
Keep your core braced and your legs together.
Move smoothly and do not let your hips sag.

0325.description: An incline dumbbell raise pressing overhead from shoulder height. It works the shoulders and the triceps.
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Lean back on the bench and raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Keeping your back against the bench, exhale and raise the dumbbells above your head, fully extending your arms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在上斜凳上，每只手各拿一个哑铃，放在大腿上。
向后靠在长凳上，将哑铃举至肩高，手掌朝前。
背部靠在长凳上，呼气并将哑铃举过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回肩部高度。
重复所需的重复次数。

0389.description: Seated, you extend the arms from behind the head or over the bench to work the triceps. A solid isolation move for the back of the arm.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms straight up above your head.
Slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping your elbows close to your ears.
Pause for a moment, then raise the dumbbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
双手握住哑铃，将手臂伸直至头顶上方。
慢慢地将哑铃放到脑后，保持肘部靠近耳朵。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0453.description: Seated, you lower an EZ bar behind your head and extend your arms. It builds the back of the upper arm.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the ez barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Raise the barbell overhead, fully extending your arms.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then raise the barbell back to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
正手握住 ez 杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
将杠铃举过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
保持上臂静止，弯曲肘部将杠铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后伸展双臂将杠铃举回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0517.description: An advanced kettlebell windmill where you hold the bell overhead and hinge sideways. It trains the obliques, shoulders and hips.
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold a kettlebell in your right hand, with your arm extended overhead and your palm facing forward.
Rotate your left foot slightly to the right, and shift your weight onto your left leg.
Bend your left knee and hinge at the hip, lowering your torso towards the left side.
Keep your right arm extended overhead and your eyes on the kettlebell.
As you lower your torso, allow your right leg to straighten and your right foot to pivot slightly.
Lower your torso until you feel a stretch in your left hamstring and your right arm is pointing towards the ground.
Pause for a moment, then engage your core and push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开比肩宽，脚趾稍微向外。
右手握住壶铃，手臂伸过头顶，手掌朝前。
将左脚稍微向右旋转，并将重量转移到左腿上。
弯曲左膝并铰接在臀部，将躯干向左侧降低。
保持右臂伸过头顶，眼睛盯着壶铃。
当你降低躯干时，让右腿伸直，右脚稍微转动。
降低躯干，直到感觉到左腿筋拉伸并且右臂指向地面。
暂停片刻，然后启动核心并推动左脚跟返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0581.description: On a machine, you pull the handles down and back from a high position. Targets the lats and upper back.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and foot platform to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the foot platform.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Pull the handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将座椅高度和脚踏板调整至舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，胸部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在脚踏平台上。
正手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
将手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0709.description: Between parallel bars, you lift your body and swing your hips side to side. Works the obliques and core.
instructions: Stand between two parallel bars with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place your hands on the bars and lift your body off the ground, supporting your weight on your arms.
Engage your abs and slowly lift your legs to the side, keeping them straight.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站在两根平行杠之间，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将双手放在横杆上，将身体抬离地面，用手臂支撑体重。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将双腿向一侧抬起，保持伸直。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0773.description: A standing calf raise with the smith bar resting across the shoulders. It loads the calves for strength and size.
instructions: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height that allows you to stand with your feet flat on the ground and your shoulders under the bar.
Position yourself under the bar with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on the bar for stability.
Engage your calves and slowly raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机杆调整到一个高度，使您能够双脚平放在地面上且肩膀位于杆下方。
将自己置于杠铃下方，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾向前。
将双手放在横杆上以保持稳定。
收紧小腿，慢慢将脚跟抬离地面，将身体抬起到脚趾上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0837.description: A side-lying leg lift with added weight. It strengthens the outer hip and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your side with a weight on your top thigh or ankle.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift the top leg up and slightly back.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

0901.description: A band-resisted leg kick back. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Loop the band around your ankles or anchor it low.
Stand tall and hold support.
Press one leg straight back against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

0965.description: Fold forward with your feet far apart. It stretches the hamstrings and inner thighs and eases the back.
instructions: Stand with feet about one leg-length apart and toes pointing slightly in.
Place your hands on your hips and hinge forward with a flat back.
Lower your hands to the floor under your shoulders.
Let your head hang long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
